page_title: BAY 2-0 KOL | Bayern Munich v FC Koln 13/04/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee blows for the end of today's match.

90+3' 2 - 0 GOAL! A terrible mistake leads to a goal. The defender ends up losing possession, allowing Thomas Muller (Bayern Munich) to pick up the ball before slotting it into the back of the net to make it 2:0.
90+3' Konrad Laimer (Bayern Munich) fails to time his run beyond the last defender and the linesman makes a good call by signalling for offside after seeing the whole situation unfold.
90+2' FC Koln have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
90+2' The FC Koln players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
90' Luca Waldschmidt (1. FC Koln) takes the corner, but he overhits it and none of his teammates are able to reach the ball.
90' Sven Ulreich stretches to his right and makes a brilliant save! Steffen Tigges (1. FC Koln) met a rebound outside the box and attempted to beat the keeper into the bottom left corner.
89' Dejan Ljubicic (1. FC Koln) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
89' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for FC Koln.
87' The game is interrupted now, Dejan Ljubicic (1. FC Koln) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
86' Mathys Tel (Bayern Munich) steadies himself on the edge of the box and releases a precise effort on goal that just narrowly sails past the right post.
84' Mathys Tel (Bayern Munich) tries to find Harry Kane, but he puts too much power on the through ball.
82' Leon Goretzka (Bayern Munich) plays in a hopeful cross, but it doesn't find its way to any of the attacking players. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for FC Koln.
79' It will be a substitution. Leon Goretzka (Bayern Munich) is ready to enter the pitch as Aleksandar Pavlovic walks off.
79' It is time for a substitution. Konrad Laimer (Bayern Munich) is on for Raphael Guerreiro.
76' Timo Schultz has decided to make a change. Damion Downs (1. FC Koln) replaces Faride Alidou.
76' Substitution. Jan Thielmann did his best and is replaced by Dominique Heintz (1. FC Koln).
73' The resulting set piece from FC Koln is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
70' The Bayern Munich players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
67' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Benno Schmitz (1. FC Koln) comes onto the pitch so that Linton Maina can be given a rest.
67' Timo Schultz prepares a substitution. Sargis Adamyan is replaced by Steffen Tigges (1. FC Koln).
66' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.
65' 1 - 0 Raphael Guerreiro (Bayern Munich) produces a moment of pure magic and scores a spectacular goal by striking the ball into the top left corner of the net!
64' Mathys Tel (Bayern Munich) attempts to find Thomas Muller, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
62' The manager makes a subsitution with Alphonso Davies (Bayern Munich) coming on for Noussair Mazraoui.
61' Zsolt Low decides to make a substitution. Matthijs de Ligt will be replaced by Dayot Upamecano (Bayern Munich).
59' Aleksandar Pavlovic (Bayern Munich) plays an extraordinary diagonal pass and Mathys Tel darts into free space to control the ball.
56' Luca Waldschmidt (1. FC Koln) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
54' Here comes a substitution. Luca Waldschmidt (1. FC Koln) is brought on as a substitute for Florian Kainz.
54' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.

53' Florian Kainz (1. FC Koln) rises high to head a nice lofted cross towards the middle of the goal. Unfortunately for him, his close-range effort lacks pace and Sven Ulreich makes a comfortable save.
52' Jamal Musiala (Bayern Munich) bursts pass a defender and attempts to score from the edge of the area, but the shot goes high over the bar.
50' Kingsley Coman (Bayern Munich) is substituted due to injury. Zsolt Low gives a chance to Jamal Musiala.
48' Kingsley Coman (Bayern Munich) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+2' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+1' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
45' We will have 1 min. of added time.
43' Mathys Tel (Bayern Munich) controls a pass, goes past a defender and curls a shot from the edge of the box right onto the right post.
43' Faride Alidou (1. FC Koln) leaps high to meet a lofted pass inside the six-yard box, but his header flies yards wide of the right post.

42' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) attempts to convert a lofted cross as he jumps high and heads the ball to the left side of the goal. Marvin Schwabe shows his brilliant reflexes and pulls off a glorious save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
40' Thomas Muller (Bayern Munich) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
38' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) easily beats an opponent inside the box and goes for goal, but his effort flies just wide of the left post.

38' Bayern Munich hold possession of the ball and display neat passing from player to player. They are waiting for the right moment to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
36' What was Sargis Adamyan (1. FC Koln) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
34' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) squanders a golden opportunity after striking the ball onto the post of the goal!
34' Linton Maina (1. FC Koln) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the bottom left corner, but Sven Ulreich easily deals with the threat.
32' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.
30' Linton Maina (1. FC Koln) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.

30' Raphael Guerreiro (Bayern Munich) latches on to a precise pass and one-on-one with the keeper slams the ball towards the left-hand post. Marvin Schwabe is alert, though, and leaps like a salmon to deny him.
27' Bayern Munich quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
24' Thomas Muller (Bayern Munich) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
23' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) plays a terrific long ball forward to Kingsley Coman, but he can't beat his man and the move breaks down. The ball is out of play. FC Koln will have a throw-in.

20' What a save from Sven Ulreich! Sargis Adamyan (1. FC Koln) jumps high to meet a cross and glances a promising header from close range, but the goalkeeper pulls off a brilliant save to keep it out.
17' Faride Alidou (1. FC Koln) is caught offside by the linesman and it looks like it is the right decision despite being a very close call.

15' Florian Kainz (1. FC Koln) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Frank Willenborg blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion.
13' Thomas Muller (Bayern Munich) attempts to find one of his teammates, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone. The ball goes out of play and FC Koln will have a goal kick.

12' Mathys Tel (Bayern Munich) latches on to a precise pass and one-on-one with the keeper slams the ball towards the right-hand post. Marvin Schwabe is alert, though, and leaps like a salmon to deny him.
11' Fine play by Florian Kainz (1. FC Koln) opens up space on the edge of the box for the shot, but his effort lacks accuracy and flies miles past the left post.
9' Faride Alidou (1. FC Koln) makes a yard for himself inside the box after an accurate pass and takes a shot that goes just wide of the left post.
8' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Jan Thielmann (1. FC Koln), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
7' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
5' Jacob Christensen (1. FC Koln) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
4' The Bayern Munich players are exchanging some short passes.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are on the pitch and FC Koln will have the kick-off.
Frank Willenborg will referee today's match.
